I replied to Pree in the thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 23 May deadline for the signed Thornbury Cloth Co. order form, so I treated it as an unconfirmed rumour.

- **Nothing to check it against:** #central-team has no earlier mention of Thornbury. The shared files don't include any Thornbury contract, order form or CRM file. I only looked at sources Pree can see herself.
- **The date has already passed:** today is 14 October, so 23 May could be an old date, a mix-up, or next May.
- **What I suggested:** don't treat it as a real deadline until the Thornbury contact or the account owner confirms it in writing.

I didn't create any calendar entries or reminders.
